## Fill the form, section by section
All answers are in submission/FORM-ANSWERS.md with character counts. Paste each block into the matching field:
1. team: team name, email (lead only, yours), github profile, telegram/discord, payout wallet
2. your project: project name, logo, one liner, categories, what it does, who it's for
3. how it connects to $wif: how it uses $wif, integration type (match the suggestions against the signed-in list), contract addresses, tick ok-to-feature
4. your flywheel: the three flywheel answers
5. proof of build: github repo, demo video link, live link, transactions list, how it's made, what's next
6. review: read the terms, agree, submit
